description: This file contains an abstract class implementing a registry for JSON parsable objects, handling JSON parsing and strategy selection based on type identifiers, with error handling and immutability considerations.

classes.name: AbstractJsonParsableRegistry
classes.description: An abstract generic class providing a framework for managing and parsing JSON objects with different strategies, identified by type.

methods.name: AbstractJsonParsableRegistry
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the registry with a map of parse strategies, ensuring it is not null.

methods.name: getTypes
methods.description: Returns the set of supported JSON types that this registry can parse.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into an object of type T, wrapping exceptions with additional context.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a JsonObject into an object of type T, wrapping exceptions with additional context.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Private helper that parses a JSON string into a JsonObject and then delegates to the other fromJson method.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Private helper that resolves the type from the JSON object and attempts to parse it with the appropriate strategy. Throws exception if type unknown.

methods.name: resolveType
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to determine the type identifier from a JSON object.
